solves.reasoning: (A)publish: 결과를 숨기지 않고 발표. (B)refute: 결론을 반박 가능. (C)limited: 소수 제한보다 널리 퍼져야.
(A)derive: 추가 이론 도출. (B)available: 데이터 이용 가능. (C)construct: 새 가설 구성.
(A)inspection: 검토용. (B)assumption: ~라는 가정. (C)depends: 다른 과학자 작업에 의존.
①publish✓ ②available✓ ③refute✓ ④destroy≠construct: 새 가설을 파괴? 구성해야 맞음.
①discovery✓ ②additional✓ ③concealed≠spread: 정보가 숨겨져야? 퍼져야 맞음. ④depends✓.
①experimentally✓ ②reconsider✓ ③hypotheses✓ ④accessible≠limited: rather than being limited, not accessible.
they ___ their results: 발표=publish. withhold/distort/memorize 문맥 부적합.
available for ___: 검토=inspection. destruction/invention/celebration 부적합.
___ additional theories: 도출=derive. abandon/ignore/simplify 부적합.
publish 동의어: release=공개,발표. conceal=반의어, withdraw=철회, restrict=제한.
refute 동의어: disprove=반증. confirm/accept=반의어, establish=확립.
construct 동의어: build=세우다,구성. demolish=반의어, discard=버리다, evaluate=평가.
available 반의어: restricted=제한된. accessible=동의어, sufficient/abundant=다른축.
spread 반의어: contained=억제,제한. distributed/circulated=동의어, scattered=유사어.
(A)make a discovery=이루다(성취), (B)make sb understand=사역(~하게하다). ① 이루다-~하게하다.
proposed explanation+limited evidence+further investigation=hypothesis. assumption은 증거없이 참으로 여기는 것.
their ___ (conclude): 소유격+복수명사. conclude→conclusions.
___ (experiment) prove: 동사수식=부사. experiment→experimentally.
society ___ will end up: as a whole=전체적으로. 나머지는 문맥 부적합.
make data ___: available for inspection=검토가능하게. limited to a few=반대맥락.
